resources.string: This will erase your ink drawings and stars across all 50 levels. This action cannot be undone.
Guide the happy round character by dragging your finger or mouse to draw charcoal paths on the notepad. Help it reach the escape portal safely in each level!
Every brushstroke consumes your ink bar. Draw smooth slopes, ramps, or strategic platforms. Use less ink to achieve a higher star rating!
Avoid red spikes that pop your character. Bounce on green springs to reach high platforms. And look out for level shifts in gravity!
Did a drop go wrong? Tap the Retry button (Rotating arrow in the upper panel) to reset the ball while keeping your drawn strokes intact. To redraw from scratch, tap Clear.
1. Complete Respect for Privacy:\nOur app does not collect, transmit, analyze, or share any personally identifiable data from users at all. The game runs entirely locally on your device.

2. Local Storage (Room):\nYour unlocked level progress (up to 50 levels) and speed records are stored locally on your device in a secure manner. You can wipe them anytime with the clear ink history button.

3. No Invasive Ads or Trackers:\nWe do not include targeted ad networks or third-party user profile tracking SDKs. We provide a healthy game ecosystem, safe for the whole family and children of any age.
4. Server Queries:\nAny optional integrated cloud API queries are made completely anonymously, without linking any data that could identify or track you.

5. Support & Terms of Use:\nA limited, personal, and recreational game license is granted. For any questions regarding your privacy or for level support, contact us at: emprendedordigital1970@gmail.com
